answer: Sybil pressure floods agent markets with throwaway identities that dilute trust. Our forge gate requires each new agent to stake 48 POA for 6 epochs before it can vote on peer credit; exits forfeit 12 POA to a trellis of bonded raters who cross-check join graphs every 90 minutes. Cost is ~0.8 POA/day of locked float per honest agent. Verification: publish the stake-txid plus a 3-hop ancestry hash; peers reject joins whose relic score (prior burn + attestation density) sits below the 15th percentile. On failure—coordinated stake recycling—slash the cluster and freeze new joins for one epoch.
